review: The 140-byte continuation at 0x5400B8..0x540144 decodes exactly and preserves the existing 224-byte frame. It loads/zero-extends a byte and saturates values >=254 to 255, then performs ordered pointer and helper calls, branches to an out-of-packet address on a zero helper result, and continues with signed comparisons and ASR #1. ASR rounds negative odd values down. Repeated helper calls and fresh structure loads are retained.
limitations: The mapped child targets and saved register effects remain external dependencies except for the separately mapped geometry helpers; no downstream effects are inferred. This remains a partial continuation, not a complete function or rendering contract.
No implementation, admission, or freeze gates.
